item_system.unique_passives: Items with Unique tag: only 1 instance of that passive active
item_system.named_uniques: Items sharing a named unique (e.g., Spellblade, Lifeline) cannot stack across items

tier_system.S: Best items in Wild Rift; great value and stats
tier_system.A: Strong items; great in the right situation
tier_system.B: OK items; still good in right scenarios
tier_system.C: Limited benefit; few champions can use effectively
tier_system.D: Worst items; building puts you at a disadvantage

items.name: Infinity Edge

passives.name: Infinity
passives.desc: +30% critical strike damage.

passives.name: Limit Break
passives.desc: Every 1% crit exceeding 100% converts to 0.6% bonus crit damage.

items.when_to_build: 3rd-4th item when you have 75%+ crit from other items
items.why_to_build: Massive crit damage spike; Limit Break ensures no wasted crit

items.name: Bloodthirster

passives.name: Bloody
passives.desc: +8% Physical Vamp. Critical strikes gain additional 4% physical vamp.

items.when_to_build: Need sustain + damage; vs poke comps
items.why_to_build: Best AD sustain item; crit vamp scales with other crit items

items.name: Blade of the Ruined King

passives.name: Thirst
passives.desc: +10% Omnivamp.

passives.name: Ruined Strikes
passives.desc: Attacks deal bonus physical damage equal to 8.5% (melee: 10%) of enemy's current HP on-hit. Min 15, max 60 vs monsters.

passives.name: Drain
passives.desc: Hitting a champion with 3 attacks/abilities in 2s deals 30-100 bonus magic damage and steals 25% MS for 2s. 60s CD.

limitations: Limited to 1 Blade of the Ruined King
items.when_to_build: Enemy has 2+ tanky champions
items.why_to_build: Best tank-shredding item; %HP on-hit + MS steal for kiting

items.name: Black Cleaver

passives.name: Sunder
passives.desc: Dealing physical damage applies 6% armor reduction for 6s, stacking 4 times (max 24%).

passives.name: Chase
passives.desc: Dealing physical damage grants (melee 20 / ranged 10) MS for 2s. Increased to (40/20) MS against max-stacked targets.

items.when_to_build: Team is mostly AD; enemy stacking armor
items.why_to_build: Team-wide armor reduction benefits all AD allies; HP + AH for bruisers

items.name: Trinity Force

passives.name: Spellblade
passives.desc: After using an ability, next basic attack deals 200% base AD bonus physical damage. 1.5s CD.

items.when_to_build: Champion weaves abilities between auto-attacks
items.why_to_build: Most balanced offensive item; Spellblade is massive damage; all 4 stats useful

items.name: Serylda's Grudge

passives.name: Bitter Cold
passives.desc: Damaging abilities slow enemies by 30% for 1s.

passives.name: Last Whisper
passives.desc: +30% armor penetration.

items.when_to_build: Enemy has armor stackers; your champion relies on abilities not autos
items.why_to_build: Best AD caster anti-tank item; slow adds utility to damage

items.name: Death's Dance

passives.name: Ignore Pain
passives.desc: Store 27% of all post-mitigation damage taken as a bleed that deals true damage over 3s.

passives.name: Defy
passives.desc: Champion takedowns heal 15% max HP over 2s and cleanse all stored Ignore Pain damage.

items.when_to_build: Facing burst AD threats; teamfight reset champions
items.why_to_build: Anti-burst king; Defy resets make multi-kills snowball

items.name: Guardian Angel

passives.name: Resurrect
passives.desc: Upon taking lethal damage, enter stasis for 4s then restore 50% HP and 30% mana. 210s CD.

items.when_to_build: You're the win condition and cannot afford to die
items.why_to_build: Only revive item; insurance for high-value targets

items.name: Youmuu's Ghostblade

passives.name: Wraithstep
passives.desc: While out of combat, gain ghosting and +15 MS. On attacking a champion, convert bonus to 30% AS for 4s.

items.when_to_build: Need roaming power + burst; snowballing assassin
items.why_to_build: Best roaming AD item; OOC MS for rotations; lethality for burst

items.name: Mortal Reminder

passives.name: Sepsis
passives.desc: Physical damage inflicts 40% Grievous Wounds for 3s.

passives.name: Executioner
passives.desc: Attacks against Grievous Wounds-affected targets deal bonus 5-15% AD physical damage.

items.when_to_build: Enemy has heavy healing (Soraka, Mundo, BotRK users)
items.why_to_build: Best marksman anti-heal; gives crit + AS unlike pure anti-heal items

items.name: Lord Dominik's Regards

passives.name: Giant Slayer
passives.desc: Deal 0-20% bonus physical damage based on max HP difference vs target.

passives.name: Last Whisper
passives.desc: +30% armor penetration.

items.when_to_build: Enemy has 2+ tanks/bruisers stacking armor
items.why_to_build: Best crit-based anti-tank; %armor pen + HP-scaling bonus damage

items.name: Phantom Dancer

passives.name: Shadowwalk
passives.desc: +5% movement speed.

passives.name: Spectral Waltz
passives.desc: Next attack vs champion grants 25% bonus AS + 7% MS for 3s. 10s CD reduced by 1s per attack.

items.when_to_build: Need sustained DPS + kiting mobility
items.why_to_build: Highest AS crit item; Spectral Waltz burst of speed for repositioning

items.name: Essence Reaver

passives.name: Spellblade
passives.desc: After using ability, next attack deals 100% base AD + 40% bonus AD physical damage and restores 3% max mana. 1.5s CD.

items.when_to_build: Mana-hungry AD champ that weaves abilities between autos
items.why_to_build: Solves mana issues + Spellblade damage + crit all in one

items.name: Manamune

passives.name: Awe
passives.desc: Gain bonus AD equal to 1% max mana.

passives.name: Mana Charge
passives.desc: Abilities and attacks grant 6 mana, 3s CD.

passives.name: Transform
passives.desc: At 360 stacks, transforms into Muramana (Shock: on-hit deals bonus damage based on mana).

items.when_to_build: Need mana scaling; champion spams abilities frequently
items.why_to_build: Cheap AD + mana; transforms into powerful Muramana for late game

items.name: Navori Quickblades

passives.name: Transcendence
passives.desc: Crits reduce non-ultimate ability cooldowns.

passives.name: Deft Strikes
passives.desc: Crits deal bonus AD damage.

items.when_to_build: Champion relies on abilities that benefit from CD reduction via crits
items.why_to_build: Unique crit-CDR interaction; keeps abilities rotating faster in fights

items.name: The Collector

passives.name: Death and Taxes
passives.desc: Dealing damage that would leave enemy champion below 5% HP executes them. Earn 25 bonus gold on kill.

items.when_to_build: Snowballing; need execute threshold vs high-HP targets
items.why_to_build: Execute passive secures kills; bonus gold accelerates snowball; hybrid lethality+crit

items.name: Hullbreaker

passives.name: Set Sail
passives.desc: +5% movement speed.

passives.name: Skipper
passives.desc: Every 4th attack deals 160% base AD + 5% max HP bonus damage.

passives.name: Boarding Party
passives.desc: Empowers nearby lane minions with bonus armor/MR and damage.

items.when_to_build: Split-push win condition; enemy cannot match your sidelane
items.why_to_build: Only item that empowers minions; massive turret threat when splitting

items.name: Duskblade of Draktharr

passives.name: Nightstalker
passives.desc: From stealth/unseen, next attack deals 60-160 bonus physical + 99% slow for 0.35s. Resets on takedown within 3s.

items.when_to_build: Champion has stealth access or can proc unseen condition
items.why_to_build: Burst from stealth; reset mechanic for multi-kills

items.name: Eclipse

passives.name: Ever Rising Moon
passives.desc: Hitting a champion with 2 attacks/abilities within 1.5s deals 6% max HP bonus physical + 15% MS for 2s + shield 80-280. 12s CD.

items.when_to_build: Need sustain + burst trade pattern (2-hit combo)
items.why_to_build: Omnivamp + burst passive + shield makes trades favorable

items.name: Spear of Shojin

passives.name: Dragonforce
passives.desc: Dealing ability damage grants 10% bonus AS for 6s, stacking 3 times (max 30%). Non-ultimate ability damage reduces ultimate CD.

items.when_to_build: Champion scales with ult uptime and ability spam
items.why_to_build: Only item that reduces ult CD; AS stacking for ability-heavy melee fighters

items.name: Sterak's Gage

passives.name: Lifeline
passives.desc: Taking damage below 35% HP grants shield (75% bonus HP) + 30% tenacity for 3.75s. 60s CD.

items.when_to_build: Facing burst damage; need to survive initial combo
items.why_to_build: Shield scales with bonus HP (synergy with other HP items); tenacity anti-CC

items.name: Serpent's Fang

passives.name: Shield Reaver
passives.desc: Dealing damage to shielded champions reduces their shield by 50% (ranged: 35%).

items.when_to_build: Enemy has heavy shielding (Lulu, Karma, Barrier, Sterak's)
items.why_to_build: Only anti-shield item; neutralizes shield-stacking comps

items.name: Edge of Night

passives.name: Annul
passives.desc: After not taking champion damage for 15s, gain a spell shield that blocks the next enemy ability.

items.when_to_build: Enemy has critical single-target CC you need to block
items.why_to_build: Spell shield prevents picks; HP + AH for survivability

items.name: Runaan's Hurricane

passives.name: Wind's Fury
passives.desc: Attacks fire 2 additional bolts at nearby enemies, each dealing 62% AD physical damage. Bolts apply on-hit effects.

items.when_to_build: Need AoE auto-attack damage; teamfight DPS spreading
items.why_to_build: Only multi-bolt item; spreads on-hit effects to multiple targets

items.name: Stormrazor

passives.name: Energized
passives.desc: Moving and attacking generates Energized Attack.

passives.name: Stormshot
passives.desc: Energized attacks deal 40-100 bonus magic damage and slow enemy by 75% for 0.5s.

items.when_to_build: Need pick potential with guaranteed slow on first auto
items.why_to_build: Energized slow catches targets; works with other energized items

items.name: Divine Sunderer

passives.name: Spellblade
passives.desc: After ability, next attack deals 12% (melee) or 9% (ranged) target max HP bonus physical damage, healing for same amount. Max vs monsters. 1.5s CD.

items.when_to_build: Enemy is HP-stacking; need %HP damage + sustain
items.why_to_build: Highest Spellblade %HP damage; heals for damage dealt

items.name: Wit's End

passives.name: Fray
passives.desc: Attacks deal 15-80 (based on level) bonus magic damage on-hit.

items.when_to_build: Enemy has heavy AP damage; you auto-attack frequently
items.why_to_build: Only offensive MR item; on-hit magic damage diversifies damage types

items.name: Magnetic Blaster

passives.name: Fervor
passives.desc: +5% movement speed.

passives.name: Energized
passives.desc: Moving and attacking generates Energized Attack.

passives.name: Power Blitz
passives.desc: Energized attacks gain 100 range (50 melee), deal 40-100 bonus magic damage, grant 60 MS for 0.75s. Bounces to 5 nearby enemies. Can crit. 50-80% bonus damage vs minions.

items.when_to_build: Need range extension + waveclear + energized synergy
items.why_to_build: Extends attack range; AoE bounce for teamfights; energized stacks

items.name: Guinsoo's Rageblade

passives.name: Wrath
passives.desc: Basic attacks grant +6% AS per stack (6 stacks max = 36%). At max stacks, every other attack triggers on-hit effects twice.

passives.name: Seething Strike
passives.desc: Deal 30 bonus magic damage on-hit (applies twice at max stacks).

items.when_to_build: On-hit build; need to double on-hit effects at max stacks
items.why_to_build: Double on-hit is extremely powerful on champions with strong on-hit passives

items.name: Terminus

passives.name: Juxtaposition
passives.desc: Alternating attacks grant Light (armor + MR) or Dark (armor pen + magic pen) stacks, 3 stacks each. Light grants defensive stats, Dark grants offensive penetration.

items.when_to_build: Dealing mixed damage; need both armor and magic pen
items.why_to_build: Only item granting both armor pen AND magic pen; defensive stacks for safety

items.name: Kraken Slayer

passives.name: Bring It Down
passives.desc: Every 3rd attack deals 30-90 (+35% bonus AD) bonus true damage.

items.when_to_build: Need true damage to cut through armor stackers
items.why_to_build: True damage on every 3rd hit; bypasses all resistances

items.name: Titanic Hydra

passives.name: Cleave
passives.desc: Attacks deal (melee 2% / ranged 1.5%) max HP bonus physical damage as AoE splash.

actives.name: Crescent
actives.desc: Next attack deals (melee 4% / ranged 3%) max HP bonus AoE physical damage. 10s CD.

items.when_to_build: HP-stacking build; need waveclear for split push
items.why_to_build: Damage scales with max HP; AoE splash for clearing + teamfights

items.name: Sundered Sky

passives.name: Lightshield Strike
passives.desc: First attack on each champion crits (150% damage) and heals for 140% base AD + 6% missing HP. 8s CD per target.

items.when_to_build: Need guaranteed crit + healing in extended trades
items.why_to_build: Free crit on first hit per target; missing HP heal rewards low-HP fighting

items.name: Experimental Hexplate

passives.name: Hexcharged
passives.desc: Casting ultimate grants 30% AS + 15% MS for 5s.

items.when_to_build: Champion's ult enables extended auto-attack window
items.why_to_build: Free stats on ult cast; but niche and outclassed by other options

items.name: Soul Transfer

passives.name: Soul Siphon
passives.desc: On champion takedown, permanently gain AD stacks. Stats reset on death.

passives.name: Sacrifice
passives.desc: On death, grant nearby allies bonus stats.

items.when_to_build: Extremely ahead and confident you won't die
items.why_to_build: High-risk high-reward; lose stacks on death
